alive.last_commit_message:
fix(utils): add timeouts to task-server HTTP clients (#740)

Harden HTTP helpers in common/utils/api.go by giving them explicit timeouts so the scan agent no longer hangs indefinitely when the task server accepts a connection but never replies.

- File transfers (DownloadFile/UploadFile) use a cloned default transport with ResponseHeaderTimeout (30s) and no overall Client.Timeout, allowing large files to proceed.
- Small JSON calls (GetEvaluationsDetail, LoadRemoteFingerPrints, LoadRemoteVulStruct) get an overall 2-minute request timeout.
- Both values are package variables so tests can shorten them.
- newTransferClient now falls back to a fresh http.Transport if http.DefaultTransport is not an *http.Transport.
- Added TestAPICallsTimeOutOnUnresponsiveServer covering DownloadFile and UploadFile against an unresponsive httptest server.

Local verification (squash head bfb8e4d6): go build ./common/utils/ OK, go vet ./common/utils/ OK, go test ./common/utils/ OK; full go test ./... shows no regressions vs main (0 failing packages both). CI: 'Build and test Go packages' and 'GITHUB_OPENSOURCE_SCAN_PIPELINE' both success.
